About

Keilan Nash is an artist working in gouache, watercolor, and graphite. Their work is about memory, dissociation, and nature: how a moment gets softened, distorted, or lost, and how living things keep surfacing in the gaps.

Portraits, skeletons, still lifes, and animals recur, painted in saturated color or in stark black and white.

Pronouns: she/they
